data.name: Against the Tyrant Cloud
data.description: No oppressive murk, no fascist penumbra, no dictatorial haze and no unfree emanation; no tyrannical Gloom shall ever stand a chance against the searing light of Helldiver fire.

data.name: Agent of Oblivion
data.description: 0.05% of profits are donated to Superstone National Park, as part of the Ministry of Unity's “Greener Galaxy” campaign.

data.name: Badge of Order
data.description: This sigil reaffirms the Helldiver's pledge to protect Managed Democracy, serve Managed Democracy, and uphold Managed Democracy.

data.name: Bastion of Integrity
data.description: Based on a SEAF Signaller's Cape, which was intended to enable easy location of fallen heroes by aerial recovery crews.

data.name: Blazing Samaritan
data.description: Emblazoned with the red, white, and green of the 676th Democracy Regiment, who made their final stand on the slopes of Justice Hill.

data.name: Botslayer
data.description: A cape that strikes a subroutine emulating fear into the CPUs of all Automatons who conduct visual scans of it.

data.name: Camo Cloak
data.description: The horrors of Tyranny are manifold, their minions many, but they are naught before Democracy's twin swords: overwhelming firepower, and those trained to unquestioningly wield it.

data.name: City Fighter's Resolve
data.description: The Helldivers are all that stand between Democracy and the Fascist Hordes. Trained since birth in the art of Defensive Warfare, they meet mindless legions with the steady aim of one who has seen countless battles. - Excerpt from the journal of a Charan Democracy Officer, ca. 2082 SE

data.name: Cloak of Posterity's Gratitude
data.description: A representation of the thankfulness of those infinite descendants whose liberated existence we strive to ensure.

data.name: Conductor of Brilliance
data.description: The embroidered pattern uses aluminium from Automaton motherboards, granting the once-wretched metals a new and noble purpose.

data.name: Cover of Darkness
data.description: When children have trouble sleeping, tucking them in under this cape reminds them that they are never alone, for Liberty's unseen defenders are always watching over them.

data.name: Crest of the Unsullied
data.description: With sharp geometric angles to symbolize the rigid chain of command, this cape embodies the sanctity and moral fortitude of unblemished leadership over the mud-caked warriors they direct.

data.name: Cresting Honor
data.description: The yellow is the exact shade of the Ministry of Unity's ‘Golden Gate’, leading to the Chamber of Unanimous Decision.

data.name: De-Forester's Sailcloth
data.description: This convenient cape can double as ground insulation, warming blanket, or camp roofing to the enterprising defoliator.

data.name: Defender of Our Dream
data.description: Commemorating the New Stockholm treaty on prisoners of war, this cape celebrates the right of all enemy combatants to a swift and merciful execution.

data.name: Diagram of the Noblest Payload
data.description: Rendering the Helldiver's to the battlefield in splendorous foil, this cape illustrates that in any successful military machinery, heroic humans are the most vital piece.

data.name: Dignity of Toil
data.description: Woven from coarse, industrial fibers designed to absorb sweat and oil, this cape features a spade emblem to honor Super Earth's groundbreakers, who ensure Liberty's light finds its way through any planet's crust.

data.name: Dissident's Nightmare
data.description: After extensive testing in Patriotic Rehabilitation Centers, this design was proved most terrifying to dissent-afflicted individuals.

data.name: Drape of Glory
data.description: Research suggests that Helldivers wearing this cape are seen as 17% more patriotic.

data.name: Eagle's Fury
data.description: One of the earliest to be mass-produced, this cape has been the final sight of untold numbers of Freedom's foes.

data.name: Emblem of Freedom
data.description: Created to honor the great Freedom Chant of 2-14, in which over 10,000 loyal citizens united as one to express their undying respect for Freedom.

data.name: Eternal Corona
data.description: Featuring an ancient sun symbol and a distressed look, this cape reminds us that the light of Liberty is everlasting, and will keep shining even when we ourselves have become tattered and frayed.

data.name: Executioner's Canopy
data.description: Crests the shoulders of those who deliver the final—and most indispensable—stroke of Justice.

data.name: Eye of Freedom
data.description: A mark of stalwart loyalty bestowed only to those who have proved themselves worthy through unquestioning dedication.

data.name: Eye of Liberty
data.description: Let the Second Anniversary of the Second Galactic War be witnessed by the lidless eye of Liberty, that ever-watchful orb which provides safety through its ceaseless surveillance.

data.name: Eye of the Clandestine
data.description: Those who serve Liberty from the shadows often elect to stay anonymous, moving like traceless specters through the night. May they watch over us always.

data.name: Fallen Hero's Vengeance
data.description: Our heroic fallen live on in this cape, guiding its bearer's aim to the heart of those who killed them.

data.name: Federation's Embrace
data.description: When donning the One True Flag, one must face the direction of Super Earth, recite the Super Earth Anthem, and salute one's own image in the nearest reflective surface. Wrongful discarding of this cape is a capital offense.

data.name: Foe Rent Asunder
data.description: This ancient, likely allegorical, illustration of Might triumphing over the Anguiform is seen by scholars as a symbol of humankind's supremacy in the art of violence.

data.name: Foesmasher
data.description: Durable, waterproof, and thermally-lined, surplus units of this cape are favored by domestic campers, to make tents.

data.name: Fre Liberam
data.description: Each purchase of this cape comes with a complimentary will and testament amendment form, which guarantees the soon-to-be-deceased a prominent spot on the Wall of Martyrs.

data.name: Free-Spirited Spangles
data.description: A tribute to the mischief-makers and mavericks, those trailblazers who dutifully execute their orders with universally-endearing panache. The star-crossed trail calls to mind the special kind of Freedom that can only be achieved by going very fast in very expensive state-owned vehicles.

data.name: Freedom's Tapestry
data.description: Let all who see this cape be struck still with Freedom's beauty, or struck dead with Liberty's bullets.

data.name: Gilded Quill
data.description: The golden, piercing quills symbolise the deadly and poetic Justice delivered to seditious oppositionists. Silent sanctions, delivered with unerring precision and incontestable deniability.

data.name: Harbinger of True Equality
data.description: Wearers of this cape know that even enemies of Freedom deserve to be equal. Equally dead.

data.name: Holder of the Yellow Line
data.description: Since ancient times, the yellow line has symbolized an uncrossable boundary. To don this cape is to draw that line between tyranny and liberty, between alien monstrosities and Super Earth property, and never yield the right of way.

data.name: Honored Heirloom
data.description: Should the wearer of this cape perish at the hands of Freedom's enemies, it is customary to pass the cape on to their bravest child during the funeral, inspiring the next generation to take up arms.

data.name: Humble Regalia
data.description: This modest cape has been worn by those guarding the Chamber of Unanimous Decision since time immemorial.

data.name: Independence Bringer
data.description: This cape's cropped length symbolizes the brevity of galactic conflicts, thanks to the efficiency of the Helldivers.

data.name: Ingress-81
data.description: This cape reminds us that even faced with the abyssal darkness of space, nothing can stand against our human ingenuity, our powers of collaboration, or our sheer overwhelming numbers.

data.name: Judgment Day
data.description: The Helldiver Skull is said to strike fear in the hearts of foes attempting to sneak up on those wearing this cape.

data.name: Liberty's Herald
data.description: The two stripes serve as a reminder of the two pillars of successful military campaigns: attack, and further attack.

data.name: Light of Eternal Liberty
data.description: The unimpeachable justice of this cape's design is said to blind the enemies of Freedom with its glorious light.

data.name: Mantle of True Citizenship
data.description: The featherlight construction belies the heavy burden this cape entails—to live the Creed of the True Citizen.

data.name: Mark of the Constrictor
data.description: Marks the most Free of the Free, those who will seize tyranny by the neck and squeeze until no oppression remains.

data.name: Mark of the Crimson Fang
data.description: Marks the most obedient of the obedient, those who will strike headlong at the veins of Tyranny and administer the sweet antidote of Freedom.

data.name: Martyris Rex
data.description: It is said that only the truly Democratic can lift this cape to their shoulders.

data.name: Miranda's Legacy
data.description: Although Super Citizen Miranda's true identity has been lost to time, most legal historians agree that she was once a patron of highly-efficient interrogation techniques.

data.name: Mother Eagle's Wings
data.description: Those taken under the wings of the Law can rest easy knowing that their transgressions will soon be laid bare, their harms amended, and their citizenship safely sequestered.

data.name: Order of the Venerated Ballot
data.description: Adorned with the insignia of the Order of the Venerated Ballot, a Ministry-sanctioned Patriot's Club for citizens who pledge themselves to preserving the sanctity of voting.

data.name: Over Artifice Triumphant
data.description: Humanity's intellect shines brighter than all other, piercing even the treacherous darkness that spawned the Automatons' pseude-sentience; the darkness known as computer science

data.name: Patient Zero's Remembrance
data.description: With this cape we honor the bio-warfare pioneers of Division Zero, conscripted from quarantine zones and hospices to spread their Carcino-Plague on the battlefield.

data.name: Per Democrasum
data.description: This cape honors the Eagle pilots who would follow a Stratagem beacon into the very jaws of tyranny, even when the beacon's placement seems inscrutable to the non-Helldiver mind.

data.name: Pillar of the Abyss
data.description: A cape inspired by hypothetical covert operatives—pillars of Democratic order, operating in the hostile abyss where Liberty's light cannot yet reach.

data.name: Pillars of Freedom
data.description: Woven in honor of our loyal Helldivers, whose hearts' blood is the foundation on which Super Earth is built.

data.name: Pinions of Everlasting Glory
data.description: All but ensures ascension to the immortal ranks of those enshrined in the Super Earth Digital Archive of Valorous Acts.

data.name: Pride of the Whistleblower
data.description: Granted to the Truth Enforcers' Informant of the Month, this tasteful cape conjures images of dissident blood on asphalt.

data.name: Proof of Faultless Virtue
data.description: This cape signifies that its wearer thinks, feels and acts correctly at all times, and thus bears the responsibility to educate and re-educate their fellow citizen.

data.name: Protector of the Heart
data.description: When the Illuminate threatened Super Earth, the very Heart of Democracy, the Helldivers answered the call.

data.name: Purifying Eclipse
data.description: A tribute to the liberation of Choepessa IV in the First Galactic War, in which so much orbital ordnance was detonated that its sun was occluded by ash for an entire lunar cycle.

data.name: Rags of the Fashionable
data.description: Gently stonewashed by experienced hands, this luxury cape exudes the essence of state-approved attitude.

data.name: Reaper of Bounties
data.description: This cape recalls the popular folk tale of the “Freedomslingers”: re-educated dissidents, seeking redemption on the Federation's Borderline, hunting dangerous thought-traitors in exchange for ballot bounties.

data.name: Rebar Resolve
data.description: Inside the collar is embroidered: “Wherever I may plant my shield, know that I will never yield,” and “machine washable.”

data.name: Reckoning's Cheer
data.description: When facing the enemies of Freedom this Reckoningtide, keep up the festive spirit by recalling the opening line of A Vengeant Carol: "They'll soon be dead, to begin with."

data.name: Rightful Occupier
data.description: Painted by visionary artist Silas Garm during an intense fever, this symbol represents Humanity's great Galactic endeavor: the blood-soaked dawn of Lasting Peace.

data.name: Schema Laid Bare
data.description: This cape depicts the inner workings of a medical device submitted to the Ministry of Science 70 years ago, and is bound to clear their patent approval process any day now.

data.name: Seal of General Consensus
data.description: Made famous by the SEAF commander of the same name, this seal reminds us that only perfect Unity can ensure perfect Freedom.

data.name: Shroud of the Juggernaut
data.description: Shroud of the Juggernaut is a cape and a player card in Helldivers 2.

data.name: Standard of Rapid Evacuation
data.description: Standard of Rapid Evacuation is a cape and a player card in Helldivers 2.

data.name: Standard of Safe Distance
data.description: By reminding Chemical Agents of proper distancing rules, this extraordinary innovation in cape design ensures that they never cause another unfortunate outbreak of Carcino-Plague.

data.name: Stars and Suffrage
data.description: A symbol of Super Earth's Astral Promise: that every star shall one day illuminate throngs of joyous voters.

data.name: Stone-Wrought Perseverance
data.description: When wearers stand shoulder to shoulder, this cape shows them as they truly are: an unbreakable defense, keeping Freedom safe behind an impregnable wall.

data.name: Strength in Our Arms
data.description: The symbol on this cape represents the pillars of freedom: duty, obedience, and loyalty.

data.name: Testament to Attrition
data.description: Salvaged from a deep-storage vault, this well-ventilated cape symbolizes tenacious survival. Its visible scars bestow immediate veteran status, reminding all onlookers that the spirit of tireless service is immortal.

data.name: The Breach
data.description: As documented in the bestselling graphic novel “The Breach,” the final mission of the 361st “Freedom's Flame” saw the storied unit deploy straight into the heart of a Supervolcano, sacrificing themselves to trigger an eruption and wipe out a massive Terminid swarm.

data.name: Thundering Hooves of Loyalty
data.description: No dissident or alien, no creature big or small, can ever hope to stand against the furious stampede of Managed Democracy.

data.name: Tideturner
data.description: Some say that a mere glimpse of this cape, fluttering majestically in the breeze, is enough to spur a squad to victory.

data.name: Triangulation Veil
data.description: This vision-disruptive pattern cloaks the silent crusaders whose untraceable deeds are a pure expression of true Freedom: freedom from accountability.

data.name: Tyrant Hunter
data.description: The cape's shredded hem presages the unrelenting savagery its wielder will visit upon the nemeses of Freedom.

data.name: Unblemished Allegiance
data.description: A choir of patriotic schoolchildren sings the Super Earth anthem to each cape as the final step in its production.

data.name: United in Equality
data.description: To honor the heartfelt siblinghood of the heroes who stood together, bled together, and laid down their lives together in defense of Equality-On-Sea, all Helldivers are awarded one (1) commemorative polyester cape.

data.name: Veil of the Valorous Vagabond
data.description: Legend tells of the unnamed Helldiver, wandering the edges of Super Earth's reach, delivering Democracy and leveling lawlessness wherever the tumbleweeds lead. Wear this, and keep the legend alive.

data.name: Veridical Ideology
data.description: This cape celebrates the one Veridical Ideology—Managed Democracy—a truth so self evident, it requires no proof beyond the unwavering obedience of its champions.

data.name: Vision of Freedom
data.description: Artists and sculptors have made countless attempts at depicting the face of Liberty, but the truth is that any citizen can see it—they need only requisition a mirror.

data.name: Watchful Compatriot
data.description: Watchful Compatriot is a cape and a player card in Helldivers 2.

data.name: Way of the Bandolier
data.description: The dauntless pioneers of the Great Expansion, facing the un-Democratic unknown, adopted the Way of the Bandolier. With the gusto of their covering fire making up for their modest accuracy, they strived to be perfectly aligned in their shared values, and ready to serve when called upon by the machine gun of civic duty.

data.name: Wedgeful Tricorn
data.description: Designed in homage to the triangle—the most immovable of shapes—this cape digs its heels into eye of the observer, leaving a lasting impression.

data.name: Will of the People
data.description: Contains a grain of sand from Super Earth—so its bearers carry a small piece of Liberty with them, wherever they go.

data.name: Windswept Wayfinder
data.description: It is well-documented that soldiers raised on harsh planets have an advantage when fighting in similar environments; this insight is foundational to the Democratic Youth Scouts Exchange Program.
